name: vibrantLinux
tagline: System utility to adjust color saturation of X11 screens
blurb: vibrantLinux is a GUI tool to serves the same purpose as VibranceGUI for Windows, which to modify the saturation of any given screen whenever certain programs are launched/are in focus.
